reason: The search_files tool directly returns a list of file paths that match a given pattern, which perfectly satisfies the paths array parameter for reading multiple files.
The list_directory tool returns a list of files and directories, from which an agent can parse and extract file paths to be read.
The list_directory_with_sizes tool returns a list of files and directories with their sizes, from which an agent can parse and extract file paths to be read.
The directory_tree tool provides a recursive JSON structure of files and directories, from which an agent can traverse and extract file paths to be read.
